releaseNotes: Clear Advance now gives up a customer's prepaid credit on its own, without writing off their debt and without touching loans or installments, and a cleared advance survives a PC-to-phone sync instead of reappearing. A new Last Balance Only filter shows just the customers who still carry a carried-forward balance, leaving search and sorting as they were. Sync Password still needs no receipt, and now tells an offline office, a rejected API key and an out-of-date office computer apart instead of reporting one vague failure.
